name: Piecewise Linear Spectrum Model
definition: A continuous spectral representation method that replaces discrete binning with exact positions and intensities. It assumes scalar densities, velocities, and projected velocity portions vary linearly between sample points along a viewing ray, allowing spectral lines to be modeled as trapezoidal bands with linearly varying intensity.
summary: The Piecewise Linear Spectrum Model is a continuous spectral representation for volume rendering that uses trapezoidal bands to ensure energy conservation and accurate Doppler shifts, unlike discrete binning methods.
